metrics.source_quote: The estimated total impact sits at around $6.3B.
with ~$3 billion frozen on-chain so far.

withdrawal_status.source_quote: temporarily suspended withdrawals while security checks are completed;

facts.text: Initial investigation suggests the incident may involve a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop, which let an attacker reach a service container and submit unauthorized withdrawal transactions.
facts.source_quote: the security incident may involve a compromised DevOps engineer’s laptop, which allowed an attacker to gain access to a service container and submit unauthorized withdrawal transactions

facts.text: Binance says it has found no evidence of any wallet private key leak.
facts.source_quote: We have found no evidence of any wallet private key leak.

facts.text: Binance will cover all losses from the SAFU fund and company funds, and states user funds are safe.
facts.source_quote: Binance will cover all losses from the SAFU fund and the company’s funds. User funds are safe.

facts.text: Binance has temporarily suspended withdrawals, revoked the affected address authorisation, and engaged law enforcement and blockchain intelligence partners to trace and recover funds.
facts.source_quote: engaged law enforcement and blockchain intelligence partners to trace and recover funds.

facts.text: An update clarifies that deposits remain unaffected and continue to operate as normal.
facts.source_quote: deposits remain unaffected and continue to operate as normal
